description: This file is a PHP source code for handling import of test cases, test suites, and related data in the TestLink testing management tool. It includes functions for parsing XML files, creating and updating test cases and test suites, importing custom fields and requirements, and processing attachments, with logic specific to managing test project data.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Class representing a test project in TestLink, with methods for managing test project data, including keywords and prefixes.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class representing a test case, with methods for creating, updating, and managing test case data.

classes.name: testsuite
classes.description: Class representing a test suite, with methods for creating, updating, and managing test suite data.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Class representing a user in TestLink, providing user rights and attributes management.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Tree management class for handling hierarchical data like test suites and cases.

classes.name: tlAttachmentRepository
classes.description: Class handling attachment storage and retrieval.

methods.name: importTestCaseDataFromXML
methods.description: Main function to import test case data from an XML file into the database, including processing custom fields, requirements, and attachments.

methods.name: importTestCasesFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Function to process a SimpleXML object containing test cases and import them.

methods.name: importTestSuite
methods.description: Function to import a test suite and potentially nested test cases and child test suites from SimpleXML.

methods.name: importTestSuitesFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Function to import multiple test suites from an XML structure, including handling linked custom fields and attachments.
